summary.headline: Planetary Exaltations and Falls
summary.text: Discussion of scribal notation for retrograde planets, transfers, aspects, conjunctions, and time in lunar ephemerides, followed by Chapter Eight’s account of planetary exaltations and falls. It gives the exaltation degrees of the Sun, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, and the lunar nodes in the signs.
